scope: T=0 classical zero-SOC Y stiffness and harmonic dynamics only; no renormalized thermal stiffness

definitions.rho: energy per area = rho |grad phi|^2 / 2; rho in meV
definitions.q: physical Cartesian wavevector, inverse NN distance; no 2pi rescaling
definitions.relaxation: five regular tangent variables; global azimuth gauge removed, axial spin allowed to tilt

limitations: No quantum zero-point correction to stiffness.
No global comparison with competing phases.
SOC and V are not treated.
The single-mode reduction excludes additional soft-mode endpoints.
